1. A brief description of the chemicals you encounter (names, concentrations, exposure frequency),

3. Any existing design sketches or fabric preferences you have in mind?

We will then internally check material compatibility and provide a preliminary costing for the construction approach you propose.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Company]
